• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking hasn’t updated for several days, this can still be normal. Couriers sometimes delay scans while packages are in transit or during busy periods. 
What you can do:
Wait a few days after shipment for the first scan to appear.
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s official tracking page.
If there are still no updates after 3–5 business days, contact the courier directly with the tracking number to ask about the delay.
Tracking systems can occasionally lag behind the actual movement of the package, so updates may appear later once the parcel reaches the next facility.
